meta.partialVolumeMethod: Observed MTD × calendar days ÷ covered days; source-zero current buckets are omitted from charts
warnings: Current-month volume is shown as a dashed calendar run-rate estimate when MTD data is positive; raw MTD values remain in JSON/CSV and tooltips. Source-zero current buckets are omitted rather than plotted as activity collapses.

Current-month OI is a dashed latest snapshot and is never extrapolated. Incomplete-month data is excluded from correlations; raw current MTD volume is included in the provisional venue ranking so new activity is not hidden.
Bybit and Kraken volume are total-futures proxies, not verified perpetual-only. Bybit values are not adjusted or independently reconciled; the scope mismatch is unquantified.
CEX OI is a BTC + ETH futures proxy, not all-pair perpetual OI.
CEX category totals use a fixed Binance + Bybit + Kraken universe. Coinbase International stays separate: volume starts 21 June 2023 and OI snapshot collection starts 2026-09-03T14:45:41.278Z.
Coinbase International OI is USDC notional treated as USD at 1:1. Its collected observations must not be read as a verified pre-collection or exact month-end history.

Coinbase International OI collection failed on 2026-11-04: 502 Bad Gateway: https://api.international.coinbase.com/api/v1/instruments. Retained the last valid snapshot from 2026-10-15; no new OI observation was created.
BTC display is an approximate equivalent-value conversion using Coinbase BTC/USD daily closes, not actual BTC contract quantities. Correlations remain in USD to avoid shared-denominator effects.
Perp DEX OI history covers Hyperliquid only; no free global historical series was verified.
Prediction-market aggregates before July 2024 cover Polymarket only; Kalshi starts July 2024 and Polymarket US starts October 2025.
Absent protocol observations are treated as zero inside aggregate volume sums; source gaps can therefore resemble pre-launch inactivity.
Top-10 perp DEX ranking uses observed cumulative volume including raw current MTD (never the projected run rate), so it is provisional until month-end and still favors longer-lived venues.

PaperTrade first appears in the vendor series during the current incomplete month. Its reported notional is included and visible in the provisional ranking, but Activity Atlas has not independently reconciled that venue's economic volume.
Protocol labels follow the vendor source; infrastructure or routed-liquidity attribution may overlap at the source level.
Correlation describes co-movement, not causation; small OI samples are exploratory.

sources.title: Hyperliquid daily per-market volume backbone
sources.body: Per-market base volume converted to estimated USD by 21Shares Research. Activity Atlas uses classification shares and reconciles each month to its platform-level Hyperliquid volume.

sources.title: Hyperliquid daily per-market open interest history
sources.body: Per-market USD OI with venue, builder and sector classifications. Month-end composition is reconciled to Activity Atlas's platform-level Hyperliquid OI series.

sources.title: Hyperliquid official live per-market composition
sources.body: Official Core and HIP-3 metaAndAssetCtxs plus perpConciseAnnotations. Rolling 24h volume uses dayNtlVlm; OI uses openInterest × markPx. Values are nominal USD-equivalent for chart compatibility. Official collateralToken IDs are retained on points; no cross-collateral FX conversion is applied.

sources.title: Kalshi perpetual-futures markets and daily candles
sources.body: Official one-sided notional volume and OI for public margin/perpetual markets, grouped by official asset_class and ticker.

sources.title: Kalshi open event and market snapshots
sources.body: Open-event categories with nested market 24h volume and open interest. Official volume_24h_fp and open_interest_fp are contract counts, displayed as contracts; they are not dollars paid.

sources.title: Polymarket Gamma snapshots and weekly category history
sources.body: Current event OI and rolling volume are grouped through deterministic tag classification. Historical category volume is a community weekly series; weeks are assigned to the month of their start date.
